Veterans Benefits: Virginia provides a military retirement subtraction of up to $40,000 for tax year 2025 and later, property-tax exemptions for qualifying disabled veterans and surviving spouses, certain disabled-veteran vehicle tax exemptions, education and employment assistance, military/veteran plates, hunting/fishing privileges, and free or discounted state park disability passes.

Description: Independent Northern Virginia city with a rich Civil War history, major defense technology and semiconductor manufacturing base (Lockheed Martin, BAE Systems, Micron), convenient VRE commuter rail access to Washington D.C., and proximity to VA health services at Fort Belvoir. It offers a suburban lifestyle with diverse dining and cultural amenities, balanced against Northern Virginia traffic and higher-than-average housing costs.
